reason: The Unsubscribe menuitem is in the Manage menu, which follows the APG menu pattern: menuitems have tabindex -1 and are reached by arrow keys, not Tab. Live, Tab reaches Manage, Enter opens the menu with focus on View all plans, ArrowDown moves focus to the Unsubscribe menuitem, and Enter opens the cancel-subscription dialog with focus moved into it, so it does not open only with a mouse.
